title: AI Engineer
subtitle: Build, evaluate and ship production AI: APIs, RAG, agents, MCP, evals, security and open models
description:
A hands-on route from your first well-structured prompt to AI systems you would trust in production. You start with prompting fundamentals and the major model APIs, then build retrieval-augmented generation, tool-using agents and Model Context Protocol servers. From there you learn the engineering discipline that separates a demo from a product: evaluation suites, tracing and observability, cost and latency budgets, and security testing against prompt injection and data leakage. The final stretch covers agentic coding workflows, voice and computer-use agents, running open-weight models locally and when fine-tuning is actually worth it.

Every course is free, includes copy-pasteable code with secrets kept in environment variables, and ends with a certificate you can add to LinkedIn. Courses are listed in the recommended order; skip any you already know.
outcomes: Call the major model APIs reliably with streaming, tool use, structured output and retries
Design and evaluate RAG pipelines and tool-using agents for real business tasks
Build and secure Model Context Protocol servers that connect models to your systems
Measure quality with eval suites and tracing before and after every change
Test AI features for prompt injection, data leakage and unsafe tool use
Choose between hosted, open-weight and fine-tuned models on evidence, not hype
audience: Developers adding AI features to products or internal tools
Technical marketers and founders who want to build, not just prompt
Engineers moving from prototypes to production AI systems
